name: zcoder
description: zCoder — always-on GLM multi-model orchestration for ZCode: routes every task to the right engine (vision / turbo / deep) with pinned thinking effort, plus skill-forge, a measured skill lifecycle with oracle-graded evals, Wilson-scored trials, Pareto acceptance, and 7-gate promotion.
